name: @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-desktop-shell
description: Tauri desktop application packaging for AgentSam Local Studio, including native macOS app/DMG builds, desktop bridges, and the bundled agentsamd runtime. Independent project; not affiliated with Tauri.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix ../../apps/local-studio run build:desktop && node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && node scripts/sync-local-studio-dist.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:desktop-assets && node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: echo "agentsam-desktop-shell: no TS surface yet" && exit 0
scripts.bundle: npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:desktop-assets && node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --ci
scripts.bundle:app: npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:desktop-assets && node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && tauri build --bundles app --ci
scripts.bundle:shell-only: node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --ci

author: Inner Animal Media <sam@inneranimalmedia.com>
